payload.text: Clarification 2026-11-19: the lessons log lives outside the repository that the lesson changes, in the per-user state folder. "A commit on the main branch" means a commit on the default branch of the repository that the lesson names, given to orch lesson close as that repository and commit. The command refuses by name when that repository or commit is not found.
Source: basicly-qpr2xmr.3.19 (closed) already states that .scripts/orch_errors.py moves into .basicly/core/kit/orch/ after cut4 lands. Cut4 has landed (4251da09). This record carries that move.
